chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Water purifies, and it is not purified."

key_terms.اَلْمَاءُ: water, the substance used for ritual purification
key_terms.يُطَهَّرُ: it is purified, here negated to indicate water’s primary purifying status
key_terms.يُطَهِّرُ: it purifies, meaning it removes ritual impurity from other things

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Water purifies, and it is not purified" mean in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a foundational ruling regarding water in fiqh: water serves as a means of purification for other things. It also indicates that water is not itself purified by another purifying agent in the same way, reflecting its primary status in laws of taharah.
